title: Be a registered cadastral surveyor
what: Carry out cadastral surveys only as a registered surveyor, and carry on a cadastral surveying business only as a consulting cadastral surveyor.

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person who is not a registrant must not carry out a cadastral survey

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person who is not a consulting cadastral surveyor must not carry on a business providing services relating to carrying out cadastral surveys
